_note: CRITICAL ARM, criterion E5 -- a MISSPECIFICATION PROBE, not a measurement
of gamma. At p = 3/4 Bercu (2018) eq. (3.10) gives S_k / sqrt(k log k) ->
N(0, 1), and eq. (A.3) gives E S_k^2 = k H_k exactly (H_k the harmonic
number). The logarithm is not of the article's eq. (232) form, so
Assumption 1 is FALSE here: there is no gamma for the fit to converge to
at finite k, only a local slope of sqrt(k log k) that falls like
1/2 + 1/(2 ln k) -- 0.56 at k = 4096. What this arm asks is whether the
pipeline notices: whether the pilot's gate, the omega1 fit and the
drop-leading ladder flag a fit that should not be trusted, or certify an
exponent above 1/2 with a confident interval.
Same ladder and budget as samples_calib_p0.5.json, deliberately: only p
